description: ingrain hooks: decisions at session start and before edits, learned rules after edits, both at the end of a turn. They do nothing until the ingrain binary is installed, or when the repository's own settings already run ingrain.

hooks.command: command -v ingrain >/dev/null 2>&1 && ingrain hook session-start --from-plugin || true
command -v ingrain >/dev/null 2>&1 && ingrain hook pre-tool-use --from-plugin || true
command -v ingrain >/dev/null 2>&1 && ingrain hook post-tool-use --from-plugin || true
command -v ingrain >/dev/null 2>&1 && ingrain hook stop --from-plugin || true
